description:
Title: Storage management

First, the order is read from the automatic order management system.
Then, it's checked if the first product from the order is in stock.
If it's in stock then it's withdrawn from the warehouse.
However, if it's not in stock then it's reordered from the wholesaler.
Note, that if it was necessary to wait more then 10 days for the arrival of the  product then a delivery delay penalty is automatically demanded from the wholesaler.
After the ordered product has arrived it's registered in the stock management system.
Finally, it's checked if the whole order is ready for shipment.
If the order is ready for shipment, a courier is requested and the products are packed simultaneously and finally shipped.
If it isn't then the next product from the order is selected and the process starts again with checking if this order is in stock or not.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_StorageManagement" name="Storage management collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" processRef="Process_StorageManagement"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderManagementSystem" name="Automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Wholesaler" name="Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_StockManagementSystem" name="Stock management system"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Courier" name="Courier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" sourceRef="Participant_OrderManagementSystem" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductArrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Task_WaitForArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayPenalty" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RegisterStock" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Participant_StockManagementSystem"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequestCourier" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Participant_Courier"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StorageManagement" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order from automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCurrentProductStock" name="Check whether the current product is in stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CurrentProductStock" name="Is the current product in stock?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WithdrawProduct" name="Withdraw product from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderProduct" name="Reorder product from wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_WaitForArrival" name="Wait for ordered product to arrive"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_MoreThanTenDays" name="More than 10 days waiting" attachedToRef="Task_WaitForArrival" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_MoreThanTenDays">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P10D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Automatically demand delivery delay penalty"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ArrivalAndPenaltyMerge" name="Continue after arrival and any delay penalty"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in stock management system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductPathMerge" name="Continue after handling current product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckOrderReadiness" name="Check whether the whole order is ready for shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReady" name="Is the whole order ready for shipment?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from the order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShippingSplit" name="Arrange shipment and pack products"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShippingJoin" name="Courier requested and products packed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipProducts" name="Ship products"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Shipped" name="Order shipped"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ReadOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_StorageManagement" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadOrder_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Task_CheckCurrentProductStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock_StockGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckCurrentProductStock" targetRef="Gateway_CurrentProductStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockGateway_Withdraw" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_CurrentProductStock" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">currentProductIsInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockGateway_Reorder" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_CurrentProductStock" targetRef="Task_ReorderProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not currentProductIsInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdraw_ProductMerge" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductPathMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_Wait" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Task_WaitForArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_ArrivalMerge" sourceRef="Task_WaitForArrival" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalAndPenaltyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Timer_DemandPenalty" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_MoreThanTenDays" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Penalty_ArrivalMerge" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalAndPenaltyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrivalMerge_Register" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrivalAndPenaltyMerge" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_ProductMerge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductPathMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductMerge_CheckReadiness" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductPathMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckOrderReadiness"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckReadiness_OrderReady" sourceRef="Task_CheckOrderReadiness" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReady_Shipping" name="Ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">wholeOrderIsReadyForShipment</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderNotReady_SelectNext" name="Not ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not wholeOrderIsReadyForShipment</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectNext_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckCurrentProductStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingSplit_RequestCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingSplit_PackProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestCourier_ShippingJoin" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackProducts_ShippingJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShippingJoin_ShipProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipProducts_End" sourceRef="Task_ShipProducts" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
